title: Using the railway network as a flatbed scanner
content: Researchers propose using railway networks as large-scale flatbed scanners. The concept leverages trains equipped with sensors to continuously capture data about track conditions, surrounding infrastructure, or terrain. As trains travel fixed routes repeatedly, they can build detailed, updated maps through accumulated passes. This approach turns existing transportation infrastructure into a distributed scanning system without requiring dedicated survey vehicles.

title: 中国咖啡一哥，换对手了
content: Luckin Coffee's main rivals are shifting strategy in 2026. Cotti Coffee slowed expansion and ended its buyback policy for struggling franchisees, while Lucky Cup capped new openings and Starbucks China restructured via a joint venture with Boyu Capital. Meanwhile, Luckin accelerated: Q2 2026 revenue hit 15.9 billion yuan, up 28.5%; global stores reached 36,310. Its advantages lie in supply chain integration—direct Yunnan coffee procurement, rail freight, and four roasting hubs—and a digital system managing procurement, logistics, and product development across 113 million monthly customers. Tea chains like ChaPanda and Good Me are now entering coffee, while Luckin pushes into tea and overseas markets, blurring category boundaries.

title: “代工之王”郭台铭二十年转型执念落地，万亿算力龙头估值全靠AI景气续命
content: Foxconn founder Terry Gou's two-decade effort to transform his company from a low-margin assembler into a high-value technology firm culminated in the 2015 creation of Foxconn Industrial Internet (FII). The company's 2026 first-half results show dramatic growth: cloud computing revenue surged 75.7% year-over-year, AI server sales jumped 2.3x, and net profit nearly doubled. Yet this transformation remains superficial. FII still occupies the same midstream manufacturing position—upstream GPU/HBM chips are monopolized by Nvidia, while downstream cloud giants control pricing and procurement decisions. The company's 520% stock surge and trillion-yuan valuation depend entirely on continued global AI capital expenditure growth, with major risks including declining capex growth rates, persistent low margins near 7%, massive inventory and debt burdens, and geopolitical supply chain vulnerabilities.

The tool offers a scalable, non-invasive approach to metabolic risk screening.

title: Turning Outward: Growing From Code to Influence
How canvases make agentic workflows visible, steerable, and cost-efficient
content: Canvases in GitHub Copilot provide durable, shared surfaces for human-agent collaboration, replacing disjointed chat threads where context gets buried. Two examples—Java Modernization Studio and Site Studio—demonstrate how canvases make workflow states explicit, decisions inspectable, and human approval points clear. Though requiring upfront investment (2,000–3,000 AI credits), they reduce repeated prompting, context loss, and rework. The repeatable pattern: define states, surface key decisions, persist progress, and require explicit approvals. This shifts interactions from prompt-by-prompt exchanges to structured, memory-enabled collaborative systems.
